thread:
Ashley: idea — run a tiny 'mini-prober' right after artifact ingestion to catch bad perf or OOMs before we queue full bench. low-cost gate.
Miguel: sounds helpful but adds latency to intake. what's the expected run time and cost per artifact?
Ashley: ~10-25s on existing infra for a 3-point latency profile, a couple of GPU-seconds. cheaper than rerouting traffic later.
Sophie: could be opt-out/opt-in depending on submitter tier or cost_budget in manifest? useful for experimental models.
Jordan: important: define a compact probe_contract so all adapters speak same language: manifest -> probe_descriptor -> probe_result. prevents custom scripts per team.
Ashley: draft probe_descriptor example:
```
{
  "profile": "mini",
  "seq_samples": [8,64,256],
  "checks": ["latency_p95","mem_peak","kv_cache_smoke"]
}
```
Miguel: also propose artifact dedupe: if registry returns signed provenance + exact binary hash, the prober can skip. saves cycles.
Sophie: signed provenance is great but watch quantization nondeterminism. we may need a runtime-signature (env, lib-versions) too.
Jordan: operationally, make the prober a standalone service (probe-service) with a thin REST/JSON API. reuse across hosted/dedicated/private. avoids duplicating harness logic.
Ashley: admission policy question: what thresholds map to auto-approve vs review? e.g., mini p95 < 350ms + mem_peak < 6GB -> auto-allow for dedicated?
Miguel: agree but add safe-fail behavior: if the mini-prober crashes or OOMs, mark "needs human review" instead of auto-reject. false negatives are costly.
Sophie: add a couple functional sanity checks: basic tokenization roundtrip, eos observed, and one golden prompt for output shape. cheap but catches broken exports.
Jordan: can we reuse smokehouse golden artifacts for the functional checks? that would reduce duplication but needs small interface changes. I'll sketch the adapter changes.
Ashley: blockers: infra bench quota, auth of probe-service (service tokens), and final manifest schema. timeline?
Miguel: model intake is increasing this sprint. we should land RFC fast.
Ashley: plan — RFC this week; probe-service minimal POC next sprint. I'll spin up a short RFC doc.
Sophie: I'll prepare a sample manifest with cost_budget and a couple golden prompts to attach.
onboard-bot: Task created: ONB-3499 - RFC + probe-service POC for mini-prober :memo:
Jordan: one more rule: allow skipping mini-prober only when registry provides signed provenance AND matching runtime_signature. otherwise run it.
Miguel: noted. also add a small audit log entry to the model record with probe_result hash for future reasoning.
Ashley: perfect. follow-up sync tomorrow 09:30 to finalize manifest fields and gate thresholds. :calendar:
